# api-docs

API documentation for personal access tokens: recorded examples, kumiko api-docs and a committed golden.

## README

# API docs

API documentation for personal access tokens, generated from the app itself. A helpdesk
feature exposes its ticket handlers through token scopes; `kumiko api-docs` turns the
registry, the translations and recorded requests into Markdown pages, an OpenAPI file and
an `index.json` that a website or an agent can read.

## What it shows

- **Scopes decide the content.** Only handlers that a scope of the token feature reaches
  appear. `helpdesk:write:ticket:purge` is reachable from a screen but in no scope, so it is
  listed under `apiDocs.uiOnlyWrites` with a reason; without that entry the generator reports it.
- **Texts come from the feature.** Titles, descriptions and field labels per locale use the
  keys `<handler qn>:title`, `:description` and `:field:<name>`; the German pages need the
  German translations, the menu path to the token screen comes from the nav tree.
- **Examples are recordings.** The integration test sends real requests with a token through
  `recordApiExample` from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/api-examples`. UUIDs, timestamps and
  tokens are replaced by fixed values, so a recording only changes when the API changes.
- **The output is a golden.** `api-docs/` is committed and the golden test fails when the
  generator would produce something else.

## Commands

Record the examples (writes `api-examples/`, needs Postgres from `docker compose up -d`):

```
KUMIKO_RECORD_API_EXAMPLES=1 bun test --config=bunfig.integration.toml samples/recipes/api-docs/src/__tests__/api-docs.integration.test.ts
```

Regenerate the golden (empties and rewrites `api-docs/`):

```
KUMIKO_UPDATE_API_DOCS_GOLDEN=1 bun test samples/recipes/api-docs/src/__tests__/api-docs.golden.test.ts
```

Both tests run without the flags as ordinary checks.

In an app, `kumiko api-docs` writes the pages to `apiDocs.outDir` (default `api-docs`) and
`kumiko api-docs --check` compares them with the disk, so a CI step can keep them current.
The golden test pins the framework and app version in `index.json` and `openapi.json`, so
those two files differ from a real run of the command.

## Files

```
kumiko.config.ts                          features and the apiDocs block
src/feature.ts                            helpdesk feature and the token feature with its scopes
src/__tests__/api-docs.integration.test.ts   mints a token, records the examples, checks scope limits
src/__tests__/api-docs.golden.test.ts        generator output equals api-docs/
api-examples/                             recorded requests and responses
api-docs/                                 the golden output
```

import { createAuthFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-foundation";
import { defineAppConfig } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/config";
import { localeDe } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-locale-de";
import { helpdeskFeature, patFeature } from "./src/feature";

const PURGE_REASON =
  "Purging is an admin chore that stays in the app and is never offered to API clients.";

export default defineAppConfig({
  features: [createAuthFoundationFeature(), helpdeskFeature, patFeature(), localeDe()],
  includeBundled: true,
  client: { entries: ["src/client.tsx"] },
  ports: { dev: 4520, e2e: 4521, infra: { postgres: 15520 } },
  apiDocs: {
    appName: "Helpdesk",
    baseUrl: "https://helpdesk.example.com",
    locales: ["en", "de"],
    planNote: {
      en: "API tokens are included in every Helpdesk plan.",
      de: "API-Tokens sind in jedem Helpdesk-Tarif enthalten.",
    },
    uiOnlyWrites: [
      {
        pattern: "helpdesk:write:ticket:purge",
        reason: PURGE_REASON,
      },
    ],
  },
});

### src/__tests__/api-docs.golden.test.ts

```ts
// The committed api-docs/ is the golden of what `kumiko api-docs` generates for this app.
// Regenerate it with KUMIKO_UPDATE_API_DOCS_GOLDEN=1 after changing the feature, the
// translations, the config or the recordings in api-examples/.

import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, relative } from "node:path";
import {
  ApiExampleFileSchema,
  diffApiDocsOutput,
  generateApiDocs,
  type NamedApiExample,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/agent-tools";
import { allAppFeatures } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/config";
import { createRegistry } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { composeFeatures } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime";
import { z } from "zod";
import config from "../../kumiko.config";

const ROOT = join(import.meta.dir, "../..");
const GOLDEN_DIR = join(ROOT, "api-docs");
const EXAMPLES_DIR = join(ROOT, "api-examples");
const UPDATE_FLAG = "KUMIKO_UPDATE_API_DOCS_GOLDEN";

const PackageNameSchema = z.object({ name: z.string() });

function readExamples(): NamedApiExample[] {
  return readdirSync(EXAMPLES_DIR)
    .filter((fileName) => fileName.endsWith(".json"))
    .sort()
    .map((fileName) => ({
      fileName,
      file: ApiExampleFileSchema.parse(
        JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(EXAMPLES_DIR, fileName), "utf8")),
      ),
    }));
}

function readGolden(dir: string): Map<string, string> {
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return new Map();
  const files = readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true }).filter((entry) =>
    entry.isFile(),
  );
  return new Map(
    files.map((entry) => {
      const path = join(entry.parentPath, entry.name);
      return [relative(dir, path).split("\\").join("/"), readFileSync(path, "utf8")];
    }),
  );
}

describe("api-docs golden", () => {
  const appName = PackageNameSchema.parse(
    JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, "package.json"), "utf8")),
  ).name;
  const generated = generateApiDocs({
    registry: createRegistry(
      composeFeatures(allAppFeatures(config), { includeBundled: config.includeBundled === true }),
    ),
    config: {
      ...config.apiDocs,
      locales: config.apiDocs?.locales ?? ["en"],
      baseUrl: config.apiDocs?.baseUrl ?? "",
      appName: config.apiDocs?.appName ?? appName,
    },
    // Fixed so that a release does not turn the golden red.
    source: { framework: "0.0.0-recipe", app: { name: appName, version: "0.0.0" } },
    examples: readExamples(),
  });

  if (process.env[UPDATE_FLAG] === "1") {
    rmSync(GOLDEN_DIR, { recursive: true, force: true });
    for (const [path, content] of generated.files) {
      mkdirSync(dirname(join(GOLDEN_DIR, path)), { recursive: true });
      writeFileSync(join(GOLDEN_DIR, path), content);
    }
  }

  test("every documented handler is complete", () => {
    expect(generated.problems).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the committed output equals what the generator produces", () => {
    expect(diffApiDocsOutput(generated.files, readGolden(GOLDEN_DIR))).toEqual({
      missing: [],
      changed: [],
      extra: [],
    });
  });
});
```

### src/__tests__/api-docs.integration.test.ts

```ts
// Records the request/response pairs that api-docs/ shows. A normal run only asserts the
// behaviour; with KUMIKO_RECORD_API_EXAMPLES=1 the pairs are also written to api-examples/.

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { join } from "node:path";
import {
  AuthHandlers,
  createAuthEmailPasswordFeature,
  hashPassword,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-email-password";
import {
  createAuthFoundationFeature,
  resolveTokenVerifier,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-foundation";
import {
  configValuesTable,
  createConfigFeature,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/config";
import {
  apiTokenEntity,
  PatHandlers,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/personal-access-tokens";
import {
  createTenantFeature,
  tenantEntity,
  tenantMembershipsTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant";
import { seedTenantMembership } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant/seeding";
import {
  createUserFeature,
  UserHandlers,
  userEntity,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user";
import type { SessionUser, TenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { TestUsers, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { recordApiExample } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/api-examples";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
  unsafePushTables,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { z } from "zod";
import { helpdeskFeature, patFeature } from "../feature";

const TENANT: TenantId = testTenantId(1);
const EXAMPLES_DIR = join(import.meta.dir, "../../api-examples");

let stack: TestStack;
let actor: SessionUser;

async function mintToken(scopes: readonly string[]): Promise<string> {
  const minted = await stack.http.writeOk<{ token: string }>(
    PatHandlers.create,
    { name: "Integration", scopes, currentPassword: "super-long-password" },
    actor,
  );
  return minted.token;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [
      createConfigFeature(),
      createUserFeature(),
      createTenantFeature(),
      createAuthEmailPasswordFeature(),
      createAuthFoundationFeature(),
      helpdeskFeature,
      patFeature(),
    ],
    authConfig: {
      membershipQuery: "tenant:query:memberships",
      loginHandler: AuthHandlers.login,
      tokenVerifier: (raw: string) =>
        resolveTokenVerifier({ db: stack.db, registry: stack.registry }, raw),
    },
  });
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, userEntity);
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, tenantEntity);
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, apiTokenEntity);
  await unsafePushTables(stack.db, { configValuesTable, tenantMembershipsTable });

  const created = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
    UserHandlers.create,
    {
      email: "agent@example.com",
      passwordHash: await hashPassword("super-long-password"),
      displayName: "Agent",
    },
    TestUsers.systemAdmin,
  );
  await seedTenantMembership(stack.db, { userId: created.id, tenantId: TENANT, roles: ["User"] });
  actor = { id: created.id, tenantId: TENANT, roles: ["User"] };
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

const TicketRowSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  title: z.string(),
  status: z.string(),
  priority: z.string(),
});
const CreatedSchema = z.object({ data: z.object({ id: z.string() }) });
const ListedSchema = z.object({ data: z.object({ rows: z.array(TicketRowSchema) }) });
const DetailSchema = z.object({ data: TicketRowSchema });

async function denied(token: string, type: string, payload: unknown) {
  const response = await stack.http.raw(
    "POST",
    "/api/write",
    { type, payload },
    { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  );
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
}

describe("helpdesk API with a personal access token", () => {
  test("create, list, detail, update and close a ticket", async () => {
    const token = await mintToken(["tickets:write"]);
    const record = (
      name: string,
      endpoint: "/api/query" | "/api/write",
      type: string,
      payload: unknown,
    ) =>
      recordApiExample(stack.http, {
        name,
        dir: EXAMPLES_DIR,
        endpoint,
        body: { type, payload },
        token,
      });

    const created = await record("ticket-create", "/api/write", "helpdesk:write:ticket:create", {
      title: "Printer is on fire",
      priority: "high",
    });
    expect(created.status).toBe(200);
    const id = CreatedSchema.parse(created.body).data.id;

    const listed = await record("ticket-list", "/api/query", "helpdesk:query:ticket:list", {});
    expect(ListedSchema.parse(listed.body).data.rows.map((row) => row.id)).toContain(id);

    const detail = await record("ticket-detail", "/api/query", "helpdesk:query:ticket:detail", {
      id,
    });
    expect(DetailSchema.parse(detail.body).data).toMatchObject({
      title: "Printer is on fire",
      status: "open",
      priority: "high",
    });

    const updated = await record("ticket-update", "/api/write", "helpdesk:write:ticket:update", {
      id,
      version: 1,
      changes: { priority: "normal" },
    });
    expect(updated.status).toBe(200);

    const closed = await record("ticket-close", "/api/write", "helpdesk:write:ticket:close", {
      id,
      resolution: "Replaced the cartridge",
    });
    expect(closed.status).toBe(200);
    const after = await stack.http.queryOk("helpdesk:query:ticket:detail", { id }, actor);
    expect(TicketRowSchema.parse(after)).toMatchObject({ status: "closed", priority: "normal" });
  });

  test("a read-only token cannot create a ticket", async () => {
    const result = await denied(await mintToken(["tickets:read"]), "helpdesk:write:ticket:create", {
      title: "Nope",
    });
    expect(result.status).toBe(403);
    expect(result.body).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "access_denied" } });
  });

  test("a write token cannot reach the UI-only purge", async () => {
    const result = await denied(await mintToken(["tickets:write"]), "helpdesk:write:ticket:purge", {
      olderThanDays: 30,
    });
    expect(result.status).toBe(403);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// API docs sample: a helpdesk whose ticket handlers are reachable with a personal access token.
// Every handler a token scope reaches needs a description and, per locale, a title, description
// and field labels; `kumiko api-docs` turns them into the pages under api-docs/.

import { createPersonalAccessTokensFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/personal-access-tokens";
import {
  createEntity,
  createEntityExecutor,
  createSelectField,
  createTextField,
  defineFeature,
  emitEvent,
  setFields,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { failNotFound, failUnprocessable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/errors";
import { z } from "zod";

export const ticketEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_api_docs_tickets",
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    status: createSelectField({ options: ["open", "closed"] as const, default: "open" }),
    priority: createSelectField({ options: ["low", "normal", "high"] as const, default: "normal" }),
  },
});

const ticketAccess = { roles: ["Admin", "User"] } as const;

export const helpdeskFeature = defineFeature("helpdesk", (r) => {
  const { table: ticketTable, executor: ticketExecutor } = createEntityExecutor(
    "ticket",
    ticketEntity,
  );

  r.crud("ticket", ticketEntity, {
    write: { access: ticketAccess },
    read: { access: ticketAccess },
    verbs: { delete: false },
    descriptions: {
      create: "Opens a new ticket.",
      update: "Changes the title or the priority of a ticket.",
      list: "Lists tickets, newest first.",
      detail: "Returns one ticket.",
    },
  });

  const ticketClosed = r.defineEvent("ticket-closed", z.object({ resolution: z.string().min(1) }), {
    piiFields: "none",
  });

  r.writeHandler({
    name: "ticket:close",
    description: "Closes a ticket and records how it was resolved.",
    schema: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), resolution: z.string().min(1) }),
    access: ticketAccess,
    handler: async (event, ctx) => {
      const ticket = await ticketExecutor.detail({ id: event.payload.id }, event.user, ctx.db);
      if (!ticket) return failNotFound("ticket", event.payload.id);
      if (ticket["status"] === "closed") return failUnprocessable("ticket_already_closed");
      await emitEvent(ctx, ticketClosed, {
        aggregateId: event.payload.id,
        aggregateType: "ticket",
        payload: { resolution: event.payload.resolution },
      });
      return { isSuccess: true as const, data: { id: event.payload.id } };
    },
  });

  // Reachable from a screen but deliberately outside every token scope: see uiOnlyWrites in kumiko.config.ts.
  r.writeHandler({
    name: "ticket:purge",
    description: "Removes tickets that were closed long ago.",
    schema: z.object({ olderThanDays: z.number().int().min(30) }),
    access: { roles: ["Admin"] },
    handler: async () => ({ isSuccess: true as const, data: { purged: 0 } }),
  });

  const markTicketClosed = setFields(ticketTable, { status: "closed" });
  r.projection({
    name: "ticket-status",
    source: "ticket",
    table: ticketTable,
    apply: { [ticketClosed.name]: (event, tx, ctx) => markTicketClosed(event, tx, ctx) },
  });

  r.screen({
    id: "ticket-list",
    type: "entityList",
    entity: "ticket",
    columns: ["title", "status", "priority"],
  });
  r.screen({
    id: "ticket-edit",
    type: "entityEdit",
    entity: "ticket",
    layout: { sections: [{ title: "helpdesk:section.ticket", fields: ["title", "priority"] }] },
  });
  r.screen({
    id: "close-ticket",
    type: "actionForm",
    handler: "helpdesk:write:ticket:close",
    fields: { resolution: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }) },
    layout: { sections: [{ title: "helpdesk:section.close", fields: ["resolution"] }] },
  });
  r.screen({
    id: "purge-tickets",
    type: "actionForm",
    handler: "helpdesk:write:ticket:purge",
    fields: {},
    layout: { sections: [] },
  });

  r.nav({ id: "tickets", label: "helpdesk:nav:tickets", screen: "helpdesk:screen:ticket-list" });
  r.nav({ id: "settings", label: "helpdesk:nav:settings" });
  r.nav({
    id: "api-tokens",
    label: "helpdesk:nav:api-tokens",
    parent: "helpdesk:nav:settings",
    screen: "personal-access-tokens:screen:api-tokens",
  });

  r.translations({
    keys: {
      "helpdesk:nav:tickets": { en: "Tickets", de: "Tickets" },
      "helpdesk:nav:settings": { en: "Settings", de: "Einstellungen" },
      "helpdesk:nav:api-tokens": { en: "API tokens", de: "API-Tokens" },
      "helpdesk:section.ticket": { en: "Ticket", de: "Ticket" },
      "helpdesk:section.close": { en: "Close ticket", de: "Ticket schließen" },
      "helpdesk:entity:ticket:field:title": { en: "Title", de: "Titel" },
      "helpdesk:entity:ticket:field:status": { en: "Status", de: "Status" },
      "helpdesk:entity:ticket:field:priority": { en: "Priority", de: "Priorität" },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:create:title": { en: "Create ticket", de: "Ticket anlegen" },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:create:description": {
        en: "Opens a new ticket.",
        de: "Legt ein neues Ticket an.",
      },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:update:title": { en: "Update ticket", de: "Ticket ändern" },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:update:description": {
        en: "Changes the title or the priority of a ticket.",
        de: "Ändert Titel oder Priorität eines Tickets.",
      },
      "helpdesk:query:ticket:list:title": { en: "List tickets", de: "Tickets auflisten" },
      "helpdesk:query:ticket:list:description": {
        en: "Lists tickets, newest first.",
        de: "Listet Tickets, neueste zuerst.",
      },
      "helpdesk:query:ticket:detail:title": { en: "Show ticket", de: "Ticket anzeigen" },
      "helpdesk:query:ticket:detail:description": {
        en: "Returns one ticket.",
        de: "Liefert ein Ticket.",
      },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:close:title": { en: "Close ticket", de: "Ticket schließen" },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:close:description": {
        en: "Closes a ticket and records how it was resolved.",
        de: "Schließt ein Ticket und hält fest, wie es gelöst wurde.",
      },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:close:field:id": { en: "Ticket", de: "Ticket" },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:close:field:resolution": { en: "Resolution", de: "Lösung" },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:purge:title": { en: "Purge tickets", de: "Tickets bereinigen" },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:purge:description": {
        en: "Removes tickets that were closed long ago.",
        de: "Entfernt Tickets, die lange geschlossen sind.",
      },
      "helpdesk:write:ticket:purge:field:olderThanDays": {
        en: "Closed longer than (days)",
        de: "Länger geschlossen als (Tage)",
      },
      "helpdesk:entity:__action-form__:field:resolution": { en: "Resolution", de: "Lösung" },
    },
  });
});

export const PAT_RATE_LIMIT = { maxRequests: 60, windowMs: 60_000 } as const;

export function patFeature() {
  return createPersonalAccessTokensFeature({
    scopes: {
      tickets: {
        label: "Tickets",
        read: ["helpdesk:query:ticket:*"],
        write: [
          "helpdesk:write:ticket:create",
          "helpdesk:write:ticket:update",
          "helpdesk:write:ticket:close",
        ],
      },
    },
    rateLimit: PAT_RATE_LIMIT,
  });
}
```
